more_info.question: MAF Tilal Al Ghaf Community Overview

data.answer: Cycling routes, jogging trails, and paved pathways seamlessly connect the residential neighborhoods, allowing residents to easily access amenities such as the beach and community park. Locals will find convenient travel options via Hessa Street D61 from the Tilal Al Ghaf area.

The properties in Tilal Al Ghaf include townhouses, twin villas, and villas. Here are the top developments in the larger Tilal Al Ghaf neighborhood:

Serenity Mansions offers an unparalleled selection of 6 and 7-bedroom luxury mansions. The project features sophisticated event facilities for hosting parties as well as private movie theaters and lounge areas.

Another gated neighborhood in Tilal Al Ghaf is Lanal Islands. 13 ultra-premium estate residences with 7 and 8 bedrooms will be released exclusively. The surrounding turquoise waters and the serene serenity of nature inspired the design.

Elysian Mansions are opulent residences with 5 and 7 bedrooms. Greek mythology's Elysian Fields served as the inspiration for this iconic complex, whose handovers are scheduled for August 2025. Based on the floor layout and architectural style, there will be three different types of units: Hilltop, Lagoonside, and Park Lane.

Aura presents an exquisite array of 4-bedroom twin villas nestled within Tilal Al Ghaf, Dubai. These Tilal Al Ghaf villas are tailored to offer a sophisticated lifestyle. Each villa boasts a sky suite and access to premium amenities, ensuring a lavish living experience.

Alaya Tilal Al Ghaf introduces villas ranging from 4 to 6 bedrooms, spanning from 5,394 to 8,891 square feet. Select villas feature a sky suite terrace from 431 to 639 square feet. With a layout encompassing a ground floor, first floor, and penthouse, these residences provide abundant space for opulent living.

Harmony Villas at Tilal Al Ghaf present impeccably designed 4 and 5-bedroom villas, accompanied by deluxe amenities. Residents can opt for one of the four garden suite options available in Tilal Al Ghaf Harmony. These include Creative, Wellness, Canvas, or Culinary.

Tilal Al Ghaf Elan Townhouses, offering 3 and 4 bedrooms, cater to the modern family's lifestyle with verdant outdoor spaces and resort-style amenities. The facilities in these Tilal Al Ghaf townhouses are swimming pools, community areas, and fitness centers.

Amara, a villa cluster within Tilal Al Ghaf, Dubai, developed in collaboration between Majid Al Futtaim and Begrman Design House, comprises 116 distinctive twin villas comprising 3 to 5 bedrooms.

Plagette32 sets a new benchmark for residential luxury in Dubai. This Tilal Al Ghaf project features four Water Bungalows and 28 Club Villas.

Properties for Rent in Majid Al Futtaim Tilal Al Ghaf

Tilal Al Ghaf is renowned for its upscale residential properties, featuring modern architecture, high-quality amenities, and lush green spaces. When it comes to properties for rent in Tilal Al Ghaf, there are plenty of options. The rental rates for 3-bedroom villas in Tilal Al Ghaf start from AED 155,000. Meanwhile, the rental prices for the larger 4-bedroom Tilal Al Ghaf villas are available for at least AED 190,000.

Properties for Sale in Tilal Al Ghaf Location

3 bedroom villas in Tilal Al Ghaf for sale are available at the starting price of AED 2.3 million. For those interested in 4-bedroom villas, prices start from AED 3 million. Stepping up in size, 5-bedroom villas are available at the minimum price of AED 4.1 million. Larger 6-bedroom villas in Tilal Al Ghaf are priced from AED 10.2 million onwards.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Dubai Tilal Al Ghaf?

data.answer:
Tilal Al Ghaf promotes a vibrant and inclusive environment. Tilal Al Ghaf is designed to cater to families, offering a range of educational institutions, healthcare facilities, and childcare services within proximity. The community prioritizes safety and security, providing a peaceful and family-friendly atmosphere for residents of all ages.

Public Transportation in Tilal Al Ghaf Dubai

Within the community, currently, no public transportation options exist. The closest bus stop to the Tilal Al Ghaf project is the Shami Tower stop in Dubai Sports City, reachable by a 15-minute drive from completed projects in the community. The closest metro station to Tilal Al Ghaf is the UAE Exchange Metro Station, which is approximately a 15-minute drive away.

Supermarkets in Tilal Al Ghaf

Supermarkets neighboring Tilal Al Ghaf can be found in the adjacent communities of Mudon, Motor City, and Jumeirah Village Circle. Among the popular options are Favourite Supermarket JVT and VIVA Supermarket DIP, reachable by car within a 15-minute drive.

Shopping in Tilal Al Ghaf

In addition to the shopping mall situated within the Majid Al Futtaim Tilal Al Ghaf development, each residential cluster will include a community retail center. For residents seeking further shopping options, The Village Community Mall is accessible within a 13-minute drive. Alternatively, Cityland Mall, boasting 350 stores, 75 cafes, and a cinema, is situated in Wadi Al Safa 4 and can be reached by car in approximately 19 minutes. Other nearby malls include City Centre Me’aisem and Dubai Outlet Mall.

Schools Near Tilal Al Ghaf Location

Tilal Al Ghaf is home to Royal Grammar School (RGS) Guildford Dubai, offering a British curriculum from the Foundation Stage to Middle School since its establishment in 2021. However, residents may need to explore schools outside the community for a wider range of educational choices. Nearby options include GEMS Metropole School, Kings’ School Al Barsha, Jumeirah English Speaking School in Arabian Ranches, and Safa Community School, which are all reachable within a 10 to 20-minute drive.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques near Tilal Al Ghaf Area 

Residents of Tilal Al Ghaf area can easily access Sports City Mosque, located approximately 5 minutes from the neighborhood. St. Francis of Assisi Catholic Church, also known as Jebel Ali Church, serves the community. This relatively new church in Dubai is accessible within a 19-minute drive from Tilal Al Ghaf. The nearest temple in Jebel Ali Village is approximately a 17-minute drive away.

Clinics and Hospitals near Tilal Al Ghaf Dubai

Residents seeking medical care can avail themselves of Apex Medical and Dental Clinics and Mediclinic Me’aisem, situated within a 10 to 15-minute drive from Tilal Al Ghaf. For more comprehensive medical services, NMC Royal Hospital DIP, the largest healthcare provider in the UAE, is accessible within 16 minutes.

Majid Al Futtaim Tilal Al Ghaf Location & Nearby Areas

The Tilal Al Ghaf community is strategically situated in Dubai, with several neighboring areas offering a range of amenities and services. Motor City is a vibrant neighborhood located nearby. It is known for its automotive-themed attractions, residential communities, and leisure facilities. Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC) is another neighboring community that offers a mix of residential options, parks, schools, and convenient retail outlets.

Mudon is a family-friendly community near Tilal Al Ghaf known for its lush greenery, parks, and recreational facilities. Also close to the waterfront community is Dubai Sports City, a sports enthusiast hub with world-class stadiums, academies, and residential options. Jebel Ali Village is also nearby. It offers residential and commercial properties and access to schools, shopping centers, and healthcare facilities.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Tilal Al Ghaf Dubai

data.answer:
Situated strategically, Tilal Al Ghaf offers easy access to major road networks, allowing residents to easily commute to key destinations across Dubai. Additionally, retail outlets, dining options, and entertainment venues are conveniently located within the community, enhancing convenience for residents.

Restaurants near Tilal Al Ghaf Dubai

Near Tilal Al Ghaf, there is a diverse selection of dining options. Just a 9-minute drive away in Motor City, Pepe's Piri Piri offers flavorful Portuguese-style grilled chicken and a variety of other dishes, perfect for a casual dining experience. For those craving a taste of Indian cuisine, Royal Grill Restaurant, located 13 minutes away, serves up authentic flavors and aromatic dishes in a welcoming atmosphere.

Traveling a bit further, Trattoria by Cinque, reachable in 17 minutes, provides a taste of Italy with its traditional pasta dishes, wood-fired pizzas, and delectable desserts. Royal Gate Restaurant, a mere 18-minute drive away, offers a diverse menu of Middle Eastern and international cuisine, ensuring there's something to satisfy every palate. Whether craving spicy peri peri chicken, rich Indian curries, authentic Italian pasta, or Middle Eastern delights, residents of Tilal Al Ghaf have an array of dining options to explore nearby.

Beaches Near Akoya Tilal Al Ghaf Location

There are stunning white sand beaches in Tilal Al Ghaf, including the soon-to-be Alaya Beach, a private beach only accessible by the community residents.  Another fun place to be is Lagoon Al Ghaf a man-made lagoon that is perfect for kayaking, paddle boarding, and swimming. The facility also has an outdoor gym, a variety of beach-friendly activities, and designated grilling sites. This swimmable lagoon, which covers 70,000 square meters, is next to an open beach that stretches for 400 meters, offering plenty of area for leisure and entertainment.

Hotels near the Tilal Al Ghaf Dubai Area

Situated near Tilal Al Ghaf, there is a variety of hotels offering convenient accommodation options. The Radisson Hotel Dubai DAMAC Hills, located just a 7-minute drive away, provides modern rooms and suites with contemporary amenities, along with on-site dining options and recreational facilities such as a fitness center and swimming pool.

Another nearby option is the Park Inn by Radisson Dubai Motor City, reachable in 11 minutes, offering comfortable rooms, a rooftop pool, and a selection of dining venues. For those seeking a slightly longer drive, the Novotel Jumeirah Village Triangle, located 15 minutes away, offers stylish accommodations, a rooftop pool, and multiple dining options, including an international buffet restaurant and a sports bar. Whether visiting for business or leisure, these hotels near Tilal Al Ghaf provide guests with comfortable stays and convenient access to nearby attractions and amenities.

Attractions and Landmarks near Tilal Al Ghaf

Various attractions and recreational facilities are under construction in the community, including the must-awaited Hive Park. This park will host various events throughout the year, such as movie screenings and music festivals. It is also ideal for family picnics because it has designated grilling areas, walking trails, bicycle tracks, and a children's play area.

There are also many tourist destinations near the community. A 17-minute drive from the area is the Dubai Butterfly Garden, a captivating oasis in the city, enchanting visitors with its vibrant displays of fluttering wings and lush greenery. Visitors can wander through intricately landscaped gardens adorned with colorful blooms and cascading waterfalls while butterflies flit gracefully overhead. The garden also features educational exhibits, interactive displays, and informative tours, making it an immersive and enlightening experience for nature enthusiasts of all ages.

IMG Worlds of Adventure is 20 minutes away from Tilal Al Ghaf. It is one of Dubai's premier entertainment destinations, offering an exhilarating escape into fantasy and adventure. Divided into four distinct zones – Marvel, Cartoon Network, Lost Valley-Dinosaur Adventure, and IMG Boulevard – the park transports visitors into immersive worlds inspired by beloved characters and iconic franchises.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness, and Beauty

As Tilal Al Ghaf evolves, numerous fitness clubs and gyms will be nearby. The closest gym to Tilal Al Ghaf is Gymnation Motor City, reachable by car in just 11 minutes. This 24hrs gym offers state-of-the-art equipment, fitness classes, and personalized training sessions. Alternatively, Arjan Fitness Gym is another option, a 13-minute drive away.

For individuals seeking salon and spa services near Tilal Al Ghaf, L’Atelier Hair and Beauty Salon and The Den Salon are excellent choices. They are accessible by car in approximately 20 minutes.

Although there are many benefits to living in Tilal Al Ghaf, there are a few things that those moving here need to consider. One of the points of concern is that the residents in Tilal Al Ghaf may have to put up with ongoing construction operations, which could cause noise in the neighborhood. However, this problem will be resolved as soon as the community is completely ready.

Is there a school within Tilal Al Ghaf?

The community houses Royal Grammar School (RGS) Guildford Dubai providing quality education for residents' children, ensuring convenience and accessibility to schooling options.

What types of properties are available in Tilal Al Ghaf?

The community offers a variety of properties, including villas, townhouses, and apartments, catering to different lifestyle preferences and family sizes.

What are the phases of Tilal Al Ghaf?

Tilal Al Ghaf is undergoing phased development. Upon the anticipated Tilal Al Ghaf completion date, prospective investors can explore a diverse range of homes offering significantly high rental yields. The entire development is projected to be fully completed and delivered by 2027.

How big is the Tilal Al Ghaf Dubai?

The community spans an impressive 3 million square meters, including nearly 500,000 square meters of lush parks and verdant green spaces. The development is interconnected by an extensive network of 18 kilometers of scenic walking trails.

Where is Tilal Al Ghaf?

It is situated along Hessa Street, close to Dubai Studio City and Dubai Sports City

data.content:
A project by Majid Al Futtaim, Tilal Al Ghaf is an under-development community in Dubai. The 3 million square meters neighborhood features cycling and walking tracks, Lagoon Al Ghaf, overlooking Hive Beach, and fitness centers. Tilal Al Ghaf offers residents a resort-style living experience with ample green spaces, swimming pools, white sandy beaches, and much more. There are also many restaurants, shopping stores, and entertainment venues.

Located along Hessa Street (D61), Tilal Al Ghaf is expected to be fully completed by 2027. The Tilal Al Ghaf master plan includes sub-communities: Serenity Mansions, Lanal Islands, Elysian Mansions, Alaya Beach, Alaya, Harmony, Aura, Amara, Elan Tilal Al Ghaf, and District. The gated district is in proximity to Dubai Sports City and DAMAC Hills.

The community mainly has villas and townhouses, offering excellent amenities and an expansive layout. Many projects are already completed, while some are still under construction.
